systems.name: Learning
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship and short course learning episodes, supports approvals, updates, withdrawals, and learning-related events. It interacts with a relational database, message brokers, and external APIs for data processing and communication.

systems.name: Courses
systems.description: The system facilitates storing, retrieving, and managing information about courses, including apprenticeships and frameworks, funding details, levels, routes, and sector subject areas. It integrates with external APIs for data synchronization and enables caching of course-related data using Redis.

systems.name: Campaign
systems.description: This system handles campaign-related functionality, including querying and publishing content, accessing funding tools, and interacting with external APIs and services. It supports caching, secure configuration management, and messaging workflows.
capabilities: Azure Key Vault for secure configuration

systems.name: Campaign
systems.description: The system manages campaigns and tracks their interactions, including bounced emails, displayed emails, link clicks, unsubscribed contacts, and user data related to campaigns. It interfaces with a SQL Server database for data storage and retrieval.

systems.name: Funding Apprenticeship Earnings
systems.description: Manages apprenticeship earnings profiles, additional payments, instalments, and related learning data for apprenticeships and short courses. It supports operations such as approving learning, creating unapproved learning, and handling updates to earnings profiles and payments.
capabilities: Payment processing for defined delivery periods

systems.name: Payments DataLocks
systems.description: This system handles events and commands related to apprenticeship data locks, such as monitoring apprenticeship status changes, processing data lock events, and managing related caches and actors. It also appears to provide services for handling approvals and status changes for data locks within the apprenticeship payments context.
capabilities: Processing employer-provided updates to payment priorities

systems.name: Das Commitments
systems.description: This system appears to manage apprenticeships, cohorts, training programs, and related entities, including legal entities and transfer requests. It facilitates actions such as creating, updating, approving, and resolving apprenticeship-related activities.

systems.name: Reservations
systems.description: This system manages the reservation of funds for accounts, legal entities, and associated apprenticeship courses, offering functionality to create, update, delete, and validate reservations. It integrates with databases and Azure Service Bus for message handling.

systems.name: Employer Accounts
systems.description: Manages employer accounts, legal entities, PAYE schemes, employer agreements, and team member roles. Enables employers to interact with apprenticeship levy systems and other APIs.
